last.verdict: Record quarter, but a stock priced for perfection wanted more.

reasons.label: Flat margin outlook
reasons.text: Gross margin guided flat near 50.4% despite $10.25B revenue outlook, as hiring costs rise.

reasons.label: Sky-high expectations
reasons.text: Shares rose about 22% into the report and were up roughly 109% this year.

reasons.label: Guidance looked soft
reasons.text: Analysts said the revenue guide implies slower growth in chipmaking system shipments.

story: Sales fell 3% in November amid China worries, then AI demand pushed growth to 25% now. Outlooks keep rising, yet the stock slipped about 1% in May and fell again now, after roughly doubling this year.
